mapper.select: \ SELECT c.title , i.industry_name AS industryName , jg.job_name AS jobName , jr.role_name AS roleName , c.applied_field AS appliedField , c.company_name AS companyName , ct.company_type AS companyType , cl.career_name AS careerName , (SELECT question_name FROM question_category WHERE question_code = #{questionCode}) AS questionName FROM cover_letter c LEFT JOIN industry i ON c.industry_idx = i.industry_idx LEFT JOIN job_group jg ON c.job_idx = jg.job_idx LEFT JOIN job_role jr ON c.role_idx = jr.role_idx LEFT JOIN company_type ct ON c.company_idx = ct.company_idx LEFT JOIN career_level cl ON c.career_idx = cl.career_idx WHERE c.cover_letter_idx = #{coverLetterIdx}
